kebab_example: aliyun apig update-ai-model-provider --model-provider-id mp-8c13d2b4f8a1 --display-name '千问云_/_阿里云百炼' --service-ids svc-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAiModelProvider

parameters.help_en: The ID of the model provider to update. This ID is returned by the model creation provider operation and is in the format that starts with mp-
parameters.help_zh: 要更新的模型供应商 ID。该 ID 由创建模型供应商接口返回，格式以 mp- 开头
parameters.name: model_provider_id

parameters.example: 千问云 / 阿里云百炼
parameters.help_en: The display name of the model provider. This parameter is required. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 模型供应商展示名称，必填，长度不超过 128 个字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The complete set of AI service IDs to bind to the model provider. If this parameter is not specified, the existing bindings are retained. If an empty array is specified, all bindings are cleared. Duplicate and empty values are normalized
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定到该模型供应商的 AI 服务 ID 全量集合。不传时沿用现有绑定，传空数组时清空全部绑定；重复值和空值会被归一化
parameters.name: service_ids

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body for updating an AI model provider. The provider identifier and gatewayId cannot be modified
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 更新 AI 模型供应商的请求体。provider 标识和 gatewayId 不可修改
v1_body_parameters.name: body
